description: Data subjects are not adequately informed about how their personal data is collected, used, or processed. Transparency requires clear, accessible, and comprehensive information about processing activities.
applicability: Applicable to all personal data processing where data subjects should be informed. Includes direct and indirect data collection, and all subsequent processing activities.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of privacy notices, consent mechanisms, and data subject communications. Assess completeness, clarity, and accessibility of information provided.
